content_freeze_verification.why: The script WRITES paper_tree_oid and rewrites subject_commit to the current HEAD, then reports FROZEN. It re-pins rather than verifies, so a PASS from it does not establish that paper content is unchanged. Running it mutates the freeze receipt; that mutation was reverted and is NOT part of this PR.

actual_effect_of_this_packet_on_the_pin.disclosure: Adding any file under papers/orion-08-typed-state/ changes that paper's tree oid. ORION-08's pin is one of the 8 currently matching on main per issue #1625, so this PR will make it one of the mismatching ones. No existing byte is modified; the change is purely additive. Flagged rather than hidden.
